rows.grounds: the outer square enclosure of the Śrīcakra
absolutive indicating the starting point of a sequence
compound denoting the limit reaching up to the bindu
vocative address to the supreme goddess

items.question: What span of the Śrīcakra is delineated from the earth-enclosure up to the bindu?
premises: The earth-enclosure is named as the starting point.
The bindu is named as the endpoint.
The sequence is addressed to the great goddess.
items.inference: The Śrīcakra is to be understood as extending from the outer earth-enclosure to the central bindu.
uncertainties: The exact ritual or contemplative action implied by this span is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O great goddess, beginning from the earth-enclosure and extending up to the bindu.
